description: This file defines a NoteEditor component using the Lightning JS framework. It manages note editing functionalities including displaying and editing title and content, and emitting save/delete events.

classes.name: NoteEditor
classes.description: A Lightning JS component for editing notes, including title and content, with UI controls for saving and deleting.

methods.name: $onTitle
methods.description: Handler for updating the title state when the input changes.

methods.name: $onContent
methods.description: Handler for updating the content state when the textarea changes.

methods.name: $onSave
methods.description: Emits a save event with note ID, title, and content.

methods.name: $onDelete
methods.description: Emits a delete event with note ID.

calls: this.$emit('save', this.internal.id, { title: this.title, content: this.content })
